title: "The parameter is not initialized" and "Statically typed parameter must be initialized" in ROS 2: missing values, params files that don't match, null in YAML and Nav2 yaml_filename, measured
excerpt: Why rclpy raises ParameterUninitializedException and rclcpp throws UninitializedStaticallyTypedParameterException, which params files load silently but don't apply, what ros2 param shows for an unset value, and how Nav2 map_server's yaml_filename behaves. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
